facts.text: 24 NOV 2026 1:36PM by PIB Delhi The Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, will celebrate National Milk Day 2026 on 26 November 2026 at Bapu Sabhagar, Patna, Bihar.
On the occasion, Union Minister Shri Rajiv Ranjan Singh will confer the prestigious National Gopal Ratna Awards 2026 , among the highest national recognitions in the livestock and dairy sector.

The event will also witness the dedication to the nation Namaste India’s 2 LLPD (2 lakh litres per day) Milk Processing Plant at Sikandarpur, Bihta, Patna established with assistance under the Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF).
National Milk Day 2026 will witness participation from livestock farmers, milk federations, dairy cooperatives and other stakeholders from across the country.

items.title: APEDA organises stakeholder interaction programme in Varanasi
items.summary: The programme brought together exporters and government agencies to discuss key issues concerning agricultural and processed food exports, including export facilitation, packaging, logistics, market access, regulatory requirements and institutional support.

facts.text: Under the chairmanship of Chairman, APEDA, Shri Abhishek Dev, a key highlight of the programme was the virtual flag-off of the first-ever export consignment of frozen green peas and mixed vegetables from Farrukhabad, Uttar Pradesh, to Qatar.

The export demonstrates the potential to connect regional agricultural production with food-processing facilities and international supply chains, creating opportunities for farmers, Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs), processors and exporters.
He also spoke about the recently launched Bharat Krishi Niryat Yojana (BKNY), aimed at encouraging agricultural exports and strengthening export-related infrastructure and activities.

The Chairman emphasised the need for coordinated efforts among exporters, FPOs, government departments and other stakeholders to enhance the competitiveness of Indian agricultural products in global markets.
